correctness.rationale: Decompose even/odd polynomial sectors x^epsilon p(x²); change variable y=x², so alpha=mu+epsilon-1/2 and radius b=T². Exact Cauchy–Binet/reproducing-kernel determinant and Vandermonde leading minor give elementary-symmetric functions e_k(b)=D_{m,k}(alpha)b^{k(alpha+k)}(1+O(b)), where complementary Jacobi minor H_(m-k)(alpha+2k)/H_m(alpha) and Selberg S_k/k! give positive coefficient. At z=b^{alpha+2k-1}u the scaled characteristic polynomial has exactly two co-leading terms k-1,k and simple positive root D_k/D_(k-1); the remaining terms are separated by positive even exponents. This independently establishes all m ordered eigenvalues, their distinct powers, parity interlacing and relative O(T²) for fixed N/parameters. Standard Laguerre/Jacobi Hankel determinants/Selberg gamma products finish constants; N=1 condition number 1. Independently recomputed the complementary inverse-Hankel minor identity for m=3, alpha=-1/2 and 1/2 in both Laguerre and Jacobi(beta=0) cases.
